title: Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion for Efficient Document Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2605.16861v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Block Diffusion Models (BDMs) support parallel generation, flexible-length output, and KV caching, making them promising for efficient document parsing. However, existing BDMs bind denoising and cache commitment to fixed block boundaries: parallelism shrinks during intra-block denoising, while generated tokens cannot be cached until the whole block is completed. Moreover, intra-block bidirectional denoising conflicts with inter-block autoregression, creating inconsistent information flow that can challenge structure-sensitive recognition. We propose the Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion Model (PA-BDM), which replaces intra-block bidirectional denoising with causal denoising from prefix to suffix and treats the block size as a maximum candidate range rather than a fixed commitment unit. translated_title: 面向高效文档识别的前缀自适应块扩散
translated_abstract: 块扩散模型支持并行生成、灵活长度输出和KV缓存，使其在高效文档解析方面极具前景。然而，现有BDM将去噪和缓存提交绑定在固定的块边界上：块内去噪期间并行度会下降，且已生成的词元必须等到整个块完成后才能被缓存。此外，块内双向去噪与块间自回归相互冲突，造成不一致的信息流，这可能对结构敏感的识别任务构成挑战。我们提出了前缀自适应块扩散模型（PA-BDM），它用从前缀到后缀的因果去噪取代块内双向去噪，并将块大小视为最大候选范围而非固定的提交单元。PA-BDM使用置信度门控结构损失，在将训练扩展到更长的延续内容之前先构建低熵前缀。在推理……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出前缀自适应块扩散模型PA-BDM，通过前缀到后缀的因果去噪并将块大小作为最大候选范围而非固定提交单元，解决了现有块扩散模型并行度受限、缓存延迟及结构敏感识别困难的问题。
en_tdlr: PA-BDM replaces intra-block bidirectional denoising with prefix-to-suffix causal denoising and treats block size as a maximum candidate range rather than a fixed commitment, enabling more efficient and structure-aware document recognition with block diffusion models.
